title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
abstract: arXiv:2610.22350v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated customer environments with scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems, agents interact with stakeholders and operate on production-like systems to deliver working solutions. FDE-Gym scores a delivery by how much it improves the customer's own success metric, normalized between 0 (unchanged system) and 1 (reference solution), with penalties for stakeholder interactions (messages, trial runs, and waiting time). translated_abstract: 现有的智能体基准测试通常在由问题报告、规格说明或任务工单所定义的明确任务上评估智能体。真实的客户交付则不同：前沿部署工程师必须厘清模糊的需求，在运行中的系统中工作，并发掘未被明确表述的约束条件。我们提出了FDE-Gym，这是一个包含95个端到端交付任务的基准，这些任务来自横跨18个行业的20个客户场景，每一个都由行业专家根据真实交付项目改编而成。在配备剧本化利益相关方和可修改客户系统的模拟客户环境中，智能体与利益相关方互动，并在类生产系统上进行操作以交付可用的解决方案。FDE-Gym通过交付对客户自身成功指标的改善程度来进行评分，归一化到0（系统未改变）到1（参考解决方案）之间，并对利益相关方互动（消息、试运行和等待时间）施加扣分。一个在线平台允许人类……
tldr: 提出了FDE-Gym基准，包含来自18个行业20个客户场景的95个端到端交付任务，用于评估智能体在真实客户交付中厘清模糊需求、与利益相关方互动并在类生产系统中交付可用解决方案的能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, evaluating agents' ability to clarify ambiguous requirements, interact with stakeholders, and deliver working solutions in production-like customer environments.
